committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 5 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Over the last 7 days spend rose to A$146.25 from A$118.67 while clicks were 24 vs 21, pushing cost per click to A$6.09 with zero conversions recorded. The A$600 promo credit sits untouched at A$545 as the dedicated landing page test's first full data day begins tomorrow.
Impression share sits at 10% over 30 days, with 73.8% lost to rank and only 21.3% lost to budget. Budget stays fixed per the settled test rule even though rank is the bigger constraint here.
Direct sessions jumped to 33 from 7 while the homepage pulled 35 sessions and the agency page 21, a mix worth watching once the dedicated landing page takes over all paid traffic from tomorrow.

AI Assistant visits fell to 0 from 2 and Organic Search dropped to 6 from 12, while LinkedIn sessions sat at 0 despite Chris's posting, which likely means untagged links rather than no activity. Search Console data through 2 Oct (two days behind yesterday, Sun 4) shows the simpro-xero-integration page getting 119 impressions at position 11 but 0 clicks.

actions.text: Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding, get these briefed before the dedicated landing page takes all paid traffic from tomorrow.
The homepage form still fires kontrolTrackLead before the Formspree verdict, fix this to confirm-then-count so lead counts stay accurate.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still quote 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success, update these to match the current site stats.
